# One frame, captured off the pin channel of rusty's QEMU while
# qemu/display-probe ran: a write longer than the FIFO, the `ssd1306`
# crate's init sequence, the addressing window it sets before every
# flush, and the 1 KiB framebuffer in the sixteen-byte transactions that
# driver sends it in.
#
# The picture drawn is an eight-pixel square in each far corner and a
# line across the middle of the glass — geometry rather than text,
# because it can be asserted exactly and is right only if the
# addressing walked the whole of the RAM.
#
# The first two lines are the one write that crossed the FIFO: `w+` is
# more of the message before it, and reading it as a message of its own
# takes its first byte for a control byte.
#
# Captured rather than written: a fixture somebody typed proves the
# decoder reads what its author expected a driver to send.
